mn28:38.9: Paṭiccasamuppannā kho pan' ime yadidaṃ pañc' upādānakkhandhā.
mn28:38.10: Yo imesu pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu chando ālayo anunayo ajjhosānaṃ so dukkhasamudayo,
mn28:38.11: yo imesu pañcas' upādānakkhandhesu chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ so dukkhanirodho.
mn28:38.12: Ettāvatā pi kho āvuso bhikkhuno bahu kataṃ hotīti.
mn28:38.14: Attamanā te bhikkhū āyasmato Sāriputtassa bhāsitaṃ abhinandun-
